expectations.evidence: Uses `grid-template-rows` with `0fr`/`1fr` but driven by Angular animations DSL `state()`/`transition()`, not a CSS `transition` property
`overflow: hidden` is on `.accordion-body` (the grid container), not on `.accordion-content` (the child). Child only has `min-height: 0`
Uses legacy `@angular/animations` trigger with `transition(':leave', [...])` and `[@fadeLeave]` binding, not `animate.leave` HTML attribute
Grid state is toggled via `[@accordion]="animationState()"` Angular animation trigger, not a class binding
Imports `animate, state, style, transition, trigger` from `@angular/animations`
